11 · Methodology Appendix

Forecast. Tier-1 driver model: revenue growth, EBITDA margin, D&A %, capex %, and working-capital glidepaths, anchored on the company's own TTM data; analyst YAML overrides where present (labeled). Taxes at 34% on positive EBIT.

DCF. Mid-year discounting of interim UFCF; terminal value computed both by exit multiple (12x EV/EBITDA, analyst assumption) and Gordon perpetuity (4.0% growth), both discounted at year-5; the exit-multiple method is primary. Equity bridge: EV − net debt − minority − preferred; upside measured against market cap (unit-safe), target = current price x (1 + upside).

WACC. CAPM with analyst beta. Every component and fallback listed in section 4.

Assumption provenance. 3 of 3 scenarios analyst-specified (file: TOTS3.SA.yaml); remaining drivers anchored on TTM data. Notes: year-1 growth anchored to NTM consensus (+7.2%); AR/inventory/AP days unavailable; NWC projected as % of revenue.
